name: RAM and Recursion
source: Updated colloquium blurb and portrait supplied by Mike Ryu
speaker: Dr. Russ Howell
speakerRole: Professor of Mathematics · Westmont Research Associate
teaser: Recursion, computer memory, and the mathematics of pizza cuts.
abstract: Recursion is a fundamental theme in computer science, but it is not always given a robust treatment in mathematics curricula. Conversely, students of computer science do not always get exposed to the mathematical underpinnings of this fascinating topic. This talk explores recursion from mathematical and computational viewpoints, exhibits how recursive algorithms operate in computer memory, and illustrates mathematical techniques for solving various recursive problems—including how to determine the maximum number of pieces that can be formed when a pizza is cut a given number of times.
